hero.title: Somebody else's dad knows a solicitor
hero.body: That's a big part of how it works. Something you notice when you go to college is that some people know exactly what they want to do, and exactly what they need to do to achieve it. When you have 'social capital' you have the contacts that help guide you through the application process and land that interview. This platform is here to try level that field.

items.title: A wide range of volunteers
items.body: From senior execs to junior staff, we've got a contact at every level

items.title: Honest Opinions
items.body: Ask what it pays. Ask if they hate it. Ask what they'd do differently. They're here to guide you

items.title: Learn the importance of industry knowledge
items.body: Who wants to commit to a 40 year career without knowing everything about it

teasers.title: The three most important industries for planning ahead
teasers.body: These are the hardest fields to break into, knowing what to study, and how to prepare for them is vital to get a spot on a graduate programme.
teasers.note: (Don't worry, we cover the others too)

items.name: Finance
items.quote: Accountancy is the standard route post grad - Big4 training contract, but other areas are harder to break into, and require more planning. From Investment Banking to Quant Finance, some of the best paid roles are hidden behind multiple intra study internships and blocked off to those not at 'target' schools and courses.

items.name: Law
items.quote: It's not just the college degree, you also need to complete 8 FE1 examinations. However the big firms hand out their trainee contracts before the FE1s are complete. Landing these opportunities requires preparedness

items.name: Marketing
items.quote: AI is already hitting the marketing job market hard. So breaking into the field requires not only a good grade, but also an awareness of how businesses are adapting and operating to it.

industries.title: An insight into every other field
industries.body: Technology, healthcare, trades, media, education, engineering, public sector. Full profiles once your school signs up.

cta.title: Step 1. School Registration
cta.body: Sounds interesting? Pass it on to your guidance counsellor or decision maker. Once the school is signed up you can be given access to the network and begin reaching out to contacts across a wide range of industries
